_readme: Affiliate links for Smart Shopping — the ONLY place they are configured. Everything is OFF. Before turning a retailer on, read docs/AFFILIATES.md: be approved by the program, confirm its CURRENT terms allow links on each platform you list (web = your website/server pages, desktop = the downloadable desktop app, android = the Android app), and paste the exact identifiers or link template the program gave you. Never invent identifiers. Then run: python3 catalog/build_catalog.py (it refuses invalid settings).
